en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It was the same way when we went to
the library after Rantaro's class trial.
<CLT=cltMIND>...All clean.
<CLT=cltMIND>Like nothing ever happened.
Ugh, man... I'm tired as fuck.
I was up all night fixing that computer.

Ah, you took a look at the computer
on the 4th floor? What do you think?

Yeah...I only just started working on it
so I don't know the full specs, but...

That thing...is pretty good. I mean, it's so
intense it just won't let me sleep.
Kehehe...are you jealous?

...Of course not. I would never be jealous
of a computer.

A robot jealous of a computer?
It seems just plain possible.

Hey guys, am I sleepwalking or something?
What's <CLT=cltSTRONG>she<CLT=cltNORMAL> doing here?

Oh, I see! I'm hallucinating! After what Maki
said before, there's no way she'd be here!

Don't say something so stupid. You'll never get
to know her better if you never talk to her!
Maybe everyone would prefer that!

Maybe everyone would prefer that this
dangerous killer stays far away from us!
Of course, I wouldn't prefer that at all!
You better cut it out!

He's right. Murder and death have no place in
a peaceful academy life.
Nyeeeh...it's just like Angie said.
Yeah...it's just like Angie said.
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
Everyone! It serious!

Oh, no... The Colossal Insect is on the other
side of the wall, isn't it!?

No, not that. Gonta went to courtyard
before coming here and—
Thanks for bearing with us!

C'monnnnn, what is it? Why'd you call us
out all of a sudden!?

We're the ones who called them out!
Did you forget that, too?

LET'S-WORRY-ABOUT-MONOTARO...LATER,
AND-PRESENT-THE-<CLT=cltSTRONG>MOTIVE<CLT=cltNORMAL>-NOW.
So it is a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> after all.

Nyahaha! It doesn't matter what the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is, we will not do the killing game anymore.

Th-That's right! We aren't afraid of anything
anymore!
...Because we have Atua.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

But it's no ordinary <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>. This <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> will
inspire fear like never before.
Fear like never before?

IF-YOU-FACE-A-FEAR-LIKE-NEVER-BEFORE,
YOU'LL-HAVE-NO-CHOICE...BUT-TO-UNITE.

NOW, FOR-THE-MOTIVE-THAT-WILL-CAST-
YOU-DOWN-INTO-THE-DEPTHS-OF-TERROR...
...We'll present it together!
This time, the motive is a <CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Yep! A new student is transferring!
And not just any transfer student...

You get to resurrect one of the four
people who've died so far...

...and welcome them back to the
academy as a transfer student!
...Welllll?
A t-transfer student...?
We can...resurrect someone?

The instructions for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>
are written in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Necronomicon<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

By performing the ritual as written, you can
resurrect one deceased victim.

But only one of the four who have died 
so far can become the <CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Whoever you choose, that person will be
considered part of the killing game semester.

So technically, you can kill 'em again
as soon as they're resurrected.
Y'know...if you wanted to use it like that.

THIS-MOTIVE...IS-SUPPOSED-TO-BRING-
THEM-CLOSER-TOGETHER.
O-Oh...s-s-sorry! Old habits and such...

Monodam...let's forgive Monotaro.
Forgiving is what friends do, y'know.
MONOPHANIE...YOU'RE-NICE.

BUT...THERE-IS-MORE-TO-FRIENDSHIP-
THAN-BEING-NICE.

FRIENDS-ALSO-PUNISH-EACH-OTHER-
WHEN-THEY-DO-SOMETHING-WRONG.

THAT'S-WHY...I'LL-HAVE-YOU-PUNISH-
MONOTARO.
...What!? Me!?
Please, no! Not Monophanie!

I'm always mocking her when she's not
looking! I don't wanna be punished by her!
Fine, I'll do it!
<CLT=cltMIND>We were all completely dumbfounded.

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like this academy has prepared me
for absurd situations...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what I just heard was the most
absurd thing so far.

T-Transfer student...?
R-Resurrecting the dead...?

D-Don't say such a stupid thing! There's no 
way <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrecting the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL> is possible!
I-It just can't happen...

Sh-Sheesh... Wh-Who the fuck would believe
that load of unscientific bullshit?

Disbelief due to a lack of scientific merit...
is simply the hubris of a scientific society.

This ritual...or rather, <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ceremony<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
stems from <CLT=cltSTRONG>funeral ceremonies<CLT=cltNORMAL> the world over.

See? They are similar, yes? The act of sending
the dead to the next world is a sort of ritual.

Through rumors and legends, that ritual twisted
into a way to return the dead to this world.
<CLT=cltMIND>A ritual...

Since you keep rambling about it, I'm guessing
you really believe all that stuff, huh, Kiyo?

Kehehe... What are you saying?
There is no way the dead can be <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrected<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...What?

Without a doubt, the souls of the dead exist,
but they cannot be brought back to life...

Dead flesh cannot be restored,
just as broken glass cannot be mended...

So you believe in souls, but you don't believe
those souls can be resurrected?

That seems confusing, but I know if we ask, 
this conversation will just go on forever...

I-If not even Kiyo believes it, then...there's
no such thing as resurrecting the dead.

And if this idealistic degenerate can't believe
it, no reasonable girl would believe it, either!

Hmmm, you think so? I don't think it's
strange for the dead to come back to life.

Hah-hahaha! The kooky bitch is finally
talkin'!

But too bad! No one's interested in your
bullshit cult!
No...wait. Let's hear what Angie has to say.
Yes, Angie is free to speak.

Nyahahaha, can I say it?
Yaaaay! Okay, I'm gonna say it.
Cuz...that's what Atua desires.
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't follow this conversation at all...

What's wrong, Kaito?
You don't look well...

N-No...it's nothing.
I'm just...not feeling so good.
<CLT=cltMIND>All of a sudden?

Bring dead back to life...?
Gonta no can believe that.
Forest family teach Gonta...

Everything that born and everything that
die...is part of grand flow.
And flow never rewind...

Gonta would be happy if everything
that die could come back...

But even Gonta know, there no way to
take back what already happen...!

Gonta, you know about the letters
written in the courtyard, right?
Yeah...but it sorta different now.

On way here, Gonta go see writing in
courtyard...
And it have more writing this time.
More writing?

Gonta no could understand what writing
mean, but maybe...
Maybe it message from dead?

Maybe everyone leave message for us
that say, "Hey! We alive!"
A message...from everyone who died?

Cuz no one here write it, did they?
So someone else musta write it, right?

Are you saying a <CLT=cltSTRONG>dead person<CLT=cltNORMAL> hiding 
in the school wrote that message?

In other words...it's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>message from
the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

W-Wait...a <CLT=cltSTRONG>message from the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?
What the actual fuck...!?

Either way, there's nothing more divine than
being reunited with a friend.

<CLT=cltMIND>As she spoke, Angie picked the
Necronomicon off the floor.

Angie...whatever are you planning 
to do with that?

Are you...actually planning to perform the 
ritual? You do know it's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>, yes?

But perhaps it's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> that's dangerous
to ignore, rather than dangerous to use.

For example, maybe the people who've died
are actually alive...

And if we don't perform the ritual, maybe
they will be killed for certain this time?

Hm, it would be a problem if we allowed
four potential survivors to die.

Nyahaha. You're so smart for telling us, Gonta.
You're a savior to those four people.
...Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie approached Gonta with her
usual wide smile and...
Hmmmmmm...
...Ack!

You work so hard, Gonta. You're always
trying to keep everyone safe.

Even when you go berserk, you're still
considerate of everyone else, aren't you?

I know this...because Atua is always
watching you.
A-Always...watching...Gonta?
...Don't worry. You're not alone, Gonta.

Atua is like a gentle grandmother, watching
over you and keeping you safe.
Grandmas...are nice...

Gentle grandmother? I thought you
said Atua was a handsome man?

Angie's Atua changes his appearance
depending on who's looking.
Well, that's not suspiciously convenient at all.

Oh yeah. Why don't you join our <CLT=cltSTRONG>student
council<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Gonta?

Yeah! It'd be really reassuring if you were
part of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>student council<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Gonta!

Mhm...you will use your power for 
the peace of the academy.

Nyahaha! See how much everyone needs
you, Gonta? You should definitely join.
...You need Gonta?
Okay! Gonta join <CLT=cltSTRONG>student council<CLT=cltNORMAL> too!

W-Wait, before all of that, what exactly
is this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>student council<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?
Is that why you've been acting weird—

Last night, Angie summoned us to discuss
how we can eradicate the killing game.
Me, Keebo...Tenko, and Tsumugi.
And we arrived to a conclusion!

This is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy Student Council<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
with Angie Yonaga as our <CLT=cltSTRONG>president<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
...Ultimate Academy Student Council?

We've all banded together under the 
leadership of President Angie!

Our platform...is the wholesale eradication
of the killing game.

Nyeh... Our student council promises
a killing game-free Ultimate Academy.
A student council... And Angie is the president?

Yes, there can be no harmony between us
if we keep saying different things.
Oh, shut up!
What!?

Well, it's called the student council, but all
the decision-making is done by Atua.

But since Angie can speak with Atua, she's
the only one worthy of leading the council.
Nyeh...that's right.
Yeah, I'm going to follow Angie, too.

Nyahahaha! Thanks, everyone!
Atua is happy, too!
Ah geez, they've been totally brainwashed.

Kehehe... Angie has spread her influence
before we'd even realized.

But it makes sense if you think about it. This
place has all the conditions for a cult to form.

The fear of a death that cannot be avoided...
Cults are born from a desire to escape that.

So she's using this situation to take over the
school and make us dependent on "Atua."
"Using" is a rude way to describe it.

The president wants peace for this school,
and we all agree with her noble wisdom.

Yeah! Gonta not let anyone talk bad about
student council!

You literally just fuckin' joined them, you
brainwashed idiot!

But...I'm surprised Tenko decided to join
the student council.
Huh? Wh-Why?

Because you and Angie were fighting 
over Himiko, were you not?

Wh-Who cares about that...?
I...finally realized how great Atua is...

That's right, that's right...
Now what were we talking about again?
Ohhhh, that <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

Just leave this to the student council. It's
less burdensome if Atua makes the decision.
Less burdensome?

That's a relief... If it's Atua's decision, 
then it's definitely the right one.
Yeah, there's no way Atua would be wrong.
Yep, yep. Atua is always right.

Are you guys serious? The <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection
ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL> is clearly a trap.

Nyahaha, it'll be fine. As long as everyone
puts aside their desire to leave.

Kehehe... I doubt they'd listen to anything 
we'd have to say.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's true that they're probably not going
to listen, but you could at least help too, Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>What's wrong with him?
He's been quiet this whole time.

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end, we couldn't stop the
student council.

<CLT=cltMIND>We left it at that and went
our separate ways.

Nee-heehee...it's getting kinda weird now,
but at least it's not boring.
The writing in the courtyard...
Oh, yeeeah! I completely forgot about that!

Atua... I wonder what manner of god it is 
that Angie speaks of...
Does that bother you? As an anthropologist?

No, I have no interest in gods.
But I have great interest in their creators...

Humans are the ones who created gods...
and I am very interested in humanity.

I wish to know the causes and reasons
why human beings create gods.

In that sense, this school is 
most interesting.

Because it is during times of great crisis 
that humans create gods...

Kehehe... Maybe a god shall be created 
here as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>I get where Angie is coming from,
but you, Kiyo?
Imitations...?

Aside from Ryoma, who we couldn't directly 
examine, Rantaro's corpse looked very real.

Kaede and Kirumi were both "<CLT=cltSTRONG>punished<CLT=cltNORMAL>"
right before our eyes...

I cannot imagine some mannequin
could have imitated their suffering.

In addition, it is unlikely they were switched
with a fake corpse right before their demise.
...Let's listen to what Angie has to say.

Monokuma and the Exisals are evidence of
ridiculous scientific advancements...

So it may be possible for them to create
extremely convincing imitations.

What?
Don't talk to me about that.
I...want to hear Angie talk.

I...support Angie.
She'll...make everything good.
This resurrection ritual sounds stupid...

I got dragged here for this? I should've
ignored you guys after all.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>"Returning the dead to us"<CLT=cltNORMAL> is a different way
of saying the same thing.

We know Rantaro is dead, and we saw Kaede
and Kirumi die right in front of us, too.

How can they deny what we all saw?
Don't they realize how weird that is?
Wh-What?

Do you think it's strange that...I *want* to
listen to Angie?

So what? It's also important to listen to
others, so we can work together.

They were imitations!? I-I see... I never would
have thought of that!

If Angie is saying it...a dead person 
might really come back.
Hey, let's hurry up and ask her.

Yeah...all the dead bodies up till now must 
have been fake. No one's actually died.

That's what Angie's saying so it's 
probably right...

So...you believe you can...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>revive the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Angie?

Umm...I don't think the <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>
can really <CLT=cltSTRONG>bring the dead back to life<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

It's probably more like...<CLT=cltSTRONG>returning the
dead to us<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...What do you mean?

Y'know how the bodies of all the victims
have been cleaned up?

So clean, it's like there was never a dead
body to begin with? So maybe...
They were never dead to begin with?
<CLT=cltMIND>They weren't...dead?

No, that's not possible. We inspected
all of the bodies ourselves—

But, but it might've been a very accurate
imitation!
An imitation?

Monokuma and the Exisals are evidence of
ridiculous scientific advancements...

So it may be possible for them to create
extremely convincing imitations.

If that's what Angie says...
Then I'm starting to plainly agree.
I've always supported Angie...
Yayyy! Thank you, everyone!

What? No, wait a minute!
I saw them with my own eyes—

Graaahhh! Don't raise your voice to Angie,
you rude degenerate!

Hey, you don't want them to be alive, Shuichi?
You don't want the dead to be alive?

I-I do! I do want that! I wish they were
still alive... Even now I think that.
But no matter how much we want that...
Oh, wait!

If everyone alive, that mean they're somewhere
in school, right?

So...maybe one of them write message
in courtyard?
<CLT=cltMIND>The message in the courtyard?
Why do you deny me so fiercely, Shuichi?

Do you not care about those who have died?
I didn't realize you were so heartless.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's...not...true.

<CLT=cltMIND>I still want her...I want everyone
to be alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>But no matter what we do,
we can't...get them back...

H-Huh? Why...the fuck is everyone listenin'
to this crap?

Am I...the only one not fallin' for this?
And I was so sure of myself, too...

Graffiti in the courtyard?
Why's he bringing that up now!?
I don't take ideas from giant mongos!
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's hear what Angie has to say...
<CLT=cltMIND>Graffiti in the courtyard?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
Basket Goal_Right
Basket Goal_Left
